schema.entry: { value, platform: ios|android|web|all, theme: light|dark|both, source, confidence: measured|derived|assumed, note?, use?, css?, app? }
schema.value: CSS-ready string, or an object for composite values (type styles, springs). null means a gap: the value is not measured on that platform; the note says what is missing.
schema.use: Where the mock reads this entry. phone, desktop, phone+desktop (shared base), phone-black (true-black phone Messenger). Absent: recorded only.
schema.css: Shell custom property (or properties) the build writes. An object maps value fields to properties (type styles).
schema.app: packages/app/src/theme.ts key this value feeds; the entry's theme says which mode.
schema.units: Points (iOS) and dp (Android) are written as px at 1:1.

confidence.measured: read from a capture or token file this pass (or the older web measurement that this pass did not contradict)
confidence.derived: inferred: APK day/night pair matched by value, flattened alpha, a fit, a screenshot-era value not re-measured, or a rounded fit
confidence.assumed: no measurement; kept from the shell or invented, on the to-do list

schema.precedence: Phone: iOS values win. Desktop: web values win. Same platform, two captures: the newer capture wins and the note says so. Android values apply to phone only where iOS has none and never override iOS.
